verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents seven built-in ranking rules, including a 'sort' rule, which developers can reorder. Its pricing page also lists Dynamic Search Rules to boost, pin, or bury results per request. However, the evidence never shows custom ranking rules tied to document attributes such as popularity, recency, or margin, and a community user notes that decay functions for phasing out results by age are absent. missing for 10: documented custom attribute-based ranking rules for business signals (popularity, recency, margin), recency/decay functions, in-depth docs for Dynamic Search Rules, independent hands-on corroboration of business-signal tuning

support.subject: As a developer, I can shape relevance with custom ranking rules and business signals (popularity, recency, margin) beyond textual matching
